name: feature.funnels.nodes
description: Funnels feature node pack (Funnel A chat-drivability) — nodes over the ctx.features.funnels surface. Reads: `list` / `get` / `step-stats` (per-step views/completions/revenue totals). Writes: `create` and `set-steps` author DRAFT state only — publishing a funnel changes a PUBLIC surface, so it is never exposed to agents ('agent proposes, human disposes'; the promotions firewall). All role:'action' (recorded → replay-safe).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Funnels List
nodes.description: Lists the org's funnels (any status) over ctx.features.funnels. Inputs: orgId.

nodes.label: Funnel Get
nodes.description: Reads one funnel (steps, status, slug). Inputs: orgId, funnelId.

nodes.label: Funnel Create (draft)
nodes.description: Authors a funnel — agent-authored ⇒ DRAFT; a human publishes in the Funnels page (public-surface change, never auto-live). Inputs: orgId, name, slug?, steps?:[{kind,pageId,name?,routing?}].

nodes.label: Funnel Set Steps (draft edit)
nodes.description: Replaces a funnel's step list (pages validated against the workspace CMS; running step experiments are preserved by stepId). Inputs: orgId, funnelId, steps.

nodes.label: Funnel Step Stats
nodes.description: Per-step totals (views/completions/revenue/orders) from the derived rollups — the planning read for optimization proposals. Inputs: orgId, funnelId.
